verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an email/productivity service like Fastmail, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any built-in AI assistant or task delegation. The JMAP API, filters, templates, and scheduled send are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an in-product AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
